summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing for The Last Billboard. Tested all user stories, retested fixes, and performed art-direction regression, mobile responsive, and accessibility checks. Most features working correctly, but found CRITICAL stamp/message collision issue that was supposed to be fixed.

critical_bugs.issue: NEW CHECK FAILED: Stamp overlaps with message bounding box on permalink page (/m/:id) and some /fallen cards. Main agent claimed this was fixed but collision still exists.
critical_bugs.details: On /m/fad12719-53af-419b-b202-65515e8b012e: stamp bottom (723.7px) overlaps with message area (bottom: 571.2px). Also detected on fallen card 2.

critical_bugs.issue: During takeover transition, stamp elements (.stamp__l1 and .stamp__l2) not found on .poster--covered element, so heckle is not visible during the animation beat
critical_bugs.details: USER STORY 12: .poster--enter and .poster--covered appear correctly, but the stamp with heckle is not rendering on the covered poster during the ~2.5s transition

passed_tests: USER STORY 1: Wall page rendering - all elements present (the-wall, poster-stack, poster-current, rail, strip, etc.)
RETEST FIX 1 (CRITICAL): Permalink rendering works via both client-side navigation and direct URL - all required elements present and non-empty
RETEST FIX 2: Error copy on /take renders in exact sentence case: 'Say something. It won't last.' and 'The wall has standards. Barely, but it has them.'
RETEST FIX 3: Admin recap button generates Claude recap within 60s, admin-recap-text and admin-recap-copy appear correctly

USER STORY 7: /take form has all required elements (input-message maxlength=120, input-name maxlength=24, input-email, input-image, input-amount, take-submit, take-cancel). Placeholder text correct. Below-minimum and moderation errors work. Razorpay modal appears and dismissal error shows correctly.
USER STORY 9: /fallen page renders all controls and masonry. Sorting by price changes DOM order. All obituaries start with 'Here lies'.

USER STORY 10: /admin functionality - (a) seed creates new poster on wall, (b) revert restores previous holder and decreases price, (c) pause/unpause toggles clock correctly (left in PAUSED state), (d) outbox table contains dethrone emails with 'Paste over it for', (e) pending table renders
USER STORY 12: Takeover transition - .poster--enter and .poster--covered elements appear, covered poster visible during transition

USER STORY 13: Art-direction regression - NO violations found across all pages (/, /take, /m/:id, /fallen, /admin). No border-radius except 0px, no gradients except stamp__box, only .poster--top has box-shadow rgb(20,20,20) 6px 6px 0px 0px, body bg is rgb(243,231,211), fonts are Archivo Black and JetBrains Mono
USER STORY 14: Mobile 390x844 - rail is fixed to bottom, single line, no left/right overlap. Poster fills width. All form inputs reachable on /take.
ACCESSIBILITY: Rail takeover control is <button> element (when not pending), focus-visible uses outline, prefers-reduced-motion disables animation

success_percentage.critical_tests: 2 of 4 critical issues (50% - stamp collision and transition stamp visibility failed)

action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix stamp/message collision on permalink and fallen cards. The stamp is overlapping the message bounding box despite your claim that this was fixed. Check the CSS for .stamp positioning on .poster--stamped, especially for .poster--md (5/4 aspect Hall cards). Also investigate why .stamp__l1 and .stamp__l2 are not rendering on .poster--covered during the takeover transition animation.
